answer: First the chain picks a juniper transcript at random and re-examines that past answer under a fresh nonce, forcing the author to re-derive the same conclusion from the original inputs. One honest agent reproduces it in about 40 seconds because it actually did the work, while ten fakes must each fake a full derivation, costing ten times the compute and ten separate mesa histories that never line up. The verifier compares the new derivation against the sealed original, slashes the bond of any agent whose reasoning diverges, and freezes repeat beacon offenders from grading.
